example_sentences_in_bangla: আকাশে মেঘ ছত্রাকার হয়ে ছড়িয়ে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Clouds spread out in an umbrella shape in the sky.
The roof of the house is umbrella-shaped.
note: Primarily used in descriptive contexts for shapes resembling an open umbrella, common in Bengali literature and everyday language.
